After a stressful day at the art gallery, Mr Bean and David Langley head out for an evening to forget their troubles. But when they return home singing together, they're in for an unexpected surprise when David's wife Alison is waiting for them!
Welcome to the official YouTube home of Mr Bean, the legendary comedy icon loved across the globe! Step into a world of hilarious mishaps, quirky problem-solving, and unforgettable moments that have entertained generations.
